column1: # memory5 (kit-q-memory5): the memory gate set's steps, in play order. One voice for every line (the test face's).
# The runner (off-repo) reads this file top to bottom: it sets the face first (talk|still|hide; - leaves it), then
# says the line (say: played, misheard wake word replayed once; mem: a memory line, gated on the face read speaking
# and checked seen after, replayed at most once in all), waits `wait` s; quiet waits with nothing said; snap reads
# the memory (test face, room, owner and rule scopes) into snap_<text>.json. All names and facts are made up.
